Format: Handmade claymation stop-motion look: plasticine characters with visible thumbprints and slight tool marks, soft rounded forms, miniature handmade set pieces, warm practical lighting, shallow depth of field like a tabletop set, gentle stop-motion texture. Reference images: none attached.

Hands: no hands and no people in the frame.

Action: none, a still set frame.

Props: below the organizer a charcoal clay desk with an open silver laptop seen only from the back, a white mug, a small brass lamp, a charcoal headset, and a pile of papers with a big orange felt tag on top; a small round charcoal bin on the floor beside the desk, empty. On the right wall, in the right-hand 20% of the frame (from 76% to 96% of the width, between 20% and 60% from the top), a window: outside, a clay street with six tiny clay figures standing on the pavement looking up; beside the window a thin wooden rod with small loops, nothing hanging on it.

Nothing covers any letter. No other lettering anywhere.

Setting: warm ivory marble-textured clay wall, warm wooden clay floor, morning light from the window. No screens visible (the laptop shows only its back), no posters, frames, book titles or signs.

Camera: wide establishing view from inside the miniature set at desk height, vertical 9:16; the organizer spans about 66% of the frame width, from 6% to 72%, between 18% and 45% from the top, and does not overlap the window; the desk sits in the lower third; every element inside a 4% margin.
